# よむ (Yomu)

> よむ is a free, open-source pop-up dictionary for learning Japanese. Hover a word on a web page, a YouTube subtitle, a manga page, a PDF or your desktop screen to see its reading, meaning, pitch accent and audio, then save it with its sentence and review it.

## Primary Links

- [Homepage](https://yomureader.com/): What よむ is, and the install button for your browser.
- [Install](https://yomureader.com/install): Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Firefox (desktop and Android), Safari, iPhone and iPad.
- [How to learn](https://yomureader.com/learn/): The daily method in one page.
- [よむ Desktop](https://yomureader.com/desktop): Download for Windows, macOS and Linux to read Japanese anywhere on screen, including games.
- [FAQ](https://yomureader.com/faq): Short answers to common questions.
- [Privacy](https://yomureader.com/privacy/): What stays on your device and what each service receives.
- [Credits](https://yomureader.com/credits): Dictionaries, data and their licences.
- [Install userscript](https://yomureader.com/yomu.user.js): Current production userscript.
- [Source code](https://github.com/HRussellZFAC023/yomu-reader): MIT-licensed project repository.

## Apps

- [Study](https://yomureader.com/study/): Offline-first review app.
- [Video player](https://yomureader.com/video-player/): Local video and subtitle files.
- [PDF reader](https://yomureader.com/pdf-reader/): Local PDFs, scanned pages included.
- [API reference](https://yomureader.com/api/): OpenAPI contracts for Yomu services.

## Crawling Notes

- Public docs and apps are crawlable.
- Internal engineering ADRs and strategy notes are not published as docs pages.
- Canonical domain: https://yomureader.com/
- Sitemap: https://yomureader.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://yomureader.com/robots.txt
